dryRun.description: Prints each change and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

nxReleaseVersionData.description: Versions nx release set in this run, a project it left unversioned is skipped

registry.description: Registry nx release publish passes as --registry, in the form the tool names one

tag.description: Distribution tag nx release publish passes as --tag

access.description: Access level nx release publish passes as --access

otp.description: One-time password nx release publish passes as --otp

firstRelease.description: Set by nx release publish --first-release, when the registry holds no earlier version

folders.description: Folders the release build packages into, relative to the workspace root

title: Release publish
description: Attaches each folder's disk image, else its zip, at the version nx release set to the project's GitHub release; where SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY is set, adds each disk image holding a stapled notarization ticket to the Sparkle feed its app names in SUFeedURL
